Variable.Name: Rdson
Variable.Description: On resistance (Rds,on default is typical for 25C) (Ohms)

Comment.Line: Model for LMG352xR030-Q1. Automotive grade 650V, 30mOhm GaN FET with integrated driver, protection, and temperature reporting
Ron (default = 30mOhm): Adjust to estimated steady state temperature if greater thermal accuracy needed
slew rate (default = 100V/ns): Adjust to your desired slew rate determined by RDRV pin. Lower slew rate results in greater switching loss, greater heat generation.
